title: Field tensor Kunneth for natural-indexed complexes
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $A,B$ be cochain complexes of $k$-vector spaces indexed by $\mathbb N$, and let $n\in\mathbb N$. For the signed tensor total $T$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], there is a $k$-linear equivalence $e:\bigoplus_{p+q=n}H^p(A)\otimes_kH^q(B)\cong H^n(T)$. For each pair $p+q=n$ and factor cocycles $a,b$, there is a total cocycle $z$ whose inclusion is the total coprojection of the tensor of their inclusions and with $e(\operatorname{lof}_{p,q}([a]\otimes[b]))=[z]$. No schemes, sheaves, cup map, finite covers or boundedness hypotheses occur.

source.place: Tag 0BED, field tensor calculation in equation-kunneth-on-cech, and the existing natural-degree integer Kunneth theorem. Official tag pages read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BED and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0FKV.

proof.text: Extend A and B by zero; the negative terms vanish since no natural index maps to a negative integer. Apply integer-indexed tensor_kunneth_nat and obtain its equivalence and specified tensor cocycles.

Precompose with the direct sum of tensors of the inverse factor extension homology comparisons. Postcompose with homology of the normalized tensor extension isomorphism and the total extension homology comparison. Lift the natural factor cocycles by inverse extension cycle comparisons, apply the integer cycle formula, map the total cycle through the comparison and project it back. The normalized coprojection equation and the extension iCycles and homologyπ identities prove the two required formulas.

lean.statement:
theorem tensor_kunneth_natural_complexes {k : Type w} [Field k]
    (A B : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{w} k) ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : (⨁ i : {pq : ℕ × ℕ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n},
      (A.homology i.val.1) ⊗[k] (B.homology i.val.2)) ≃ₗ[k]
        (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).homology n,
      ∀ (i : {pq : ℕ × ℕ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n})
        (a : A.cycles i.val.1) (b : B.cycles i.val.2),
        ∃ z : (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k))
            (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).cycles n,
          (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k))
              (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).iCycles n z =
            ιMapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
              i.val.1 i.val.2 n i.property
              ((A.iCycles i.val.1 a) ⊗ₜ[k] (B.iCycles i.val.2 b)) ∧
          e (DirectSum.lof k _ _ i
              ((A.homologyπ i.val.1 a) ⊗ₜ[k] (B.homologyπ i.val.2 b))) =
            (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k))
              (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).homologyπ n z
